set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KWYS7H6C4XP4GGERQXXMH98S. Define ConnectivityMatrix, StaticConnectivity, DynamicConnectivity, and ConnectivitySet over typed topology/edge spaces. Invariants: square matrices for directed/undirected topologies, symmetry required for undirected values, dynamic slices share the same node/edge space, subject sets share edge ordering and subject/design alignment. Acceptance: malformed shapes fail at construction with ConnectivityError ADTs, and shared tests cover static, directed, dynamic, and subject-set cases.
set.title: Connectivity matrices, dynamic connectivity, and subject sets
